item.title: Mod Update - v6.0.0 Changelogs
item.description:
This update is focused on the new replay update and some small changes, see the details below.
And also, we are getting feedback/suggestions with the new replay update! Please don’t forget to join our Discord Server!

Changes

  • Replay v3.0 Update
    • This update will bring a complete overhaul to the current replay system, there are a lot of new features, bug fixes, QOL and more. Not to mention a complete tutorial to get you acquainted!
    • Summary of all the replay changes:
      • New Replay UI & Controls
      • Replay Tutorial
      • 1st Person POV
      • Player health, hunger, breath, inventory & more stats
      • Visualize pathing
      • Splits viewer, navigation & alignment
      • Piglin trades stat screen
      • X-ray spawners/chests/goldblocks
      • Pie chart recording
      • Player in container recording
      • Looted/Unlooted toggle for chests
      • New Timeline Icons (By ollie)
      • And more!
  • Fixed an issue where ocean seed types sometimes get both shipwreck and buried treasure at spawn.
  • Now, all strongholds will generate the same rooms/layout and still have the same amount of eyes too.
    • Still, these will be affected by other generations such as cavern, dungeon, mineshaft, etc. We are looking into a way to fix this in the future.
  • Added more splash texts.

Bug Reports

Please join our Discord Server to report any issues!
